rfis.question: B.O. deck / bottom of roof structure height is not printed anywhere (elevations show 'B.O. DECK - VARIOUS'). What height do head D/E walls (A2-3D, A6D, C3D, X6D, B2E) and soffit framing run to?

A.texto: Plans: no printed B.O. deck; elevation datum displays 'VARIOUS'; A000.A asks the GC to survey 'clear height underside of roof deck'; RCP note 4 'heights to bottom of existing structure are assumed'. Loaded 22'-10" (value hidden under 'VARIOUS' on A423.B/A425.C/A429.B/A434.A) | STAGE 3: the only PRINTED deck value is "EL.+ 22'-10"" on 6/A429.B (Bodywork) -> CONFIRMED for the A429 walls only; every other 22'-10" / 22'-5" / 21'-10" / 21'-4" sits under the printed "B.O. DECK VARIOUS" (A423.B, A425.C, A434.A) and is NOT a printed dimension -> PENDING everywhere else
A.delta: each 1 ft of deck height = +1 ft of stud per stud of all head D/E walls and soffit sides, + board on faces that go to deck

B.texto: Code: ASTM C754 / spec 09 22 16 3.2.D: extend framing full height to structural supports; no code value for the height

rfis.question: Type B2E head 'E': A301 has two details titled HEAD DETAIL (E): bubble E (stud to structural deck with 2" slip track, board ceiling + 6") and bubble H (furring against existing wall stopping a short distance above the ceiling). Which applies to B2E?

A.texto: E/A301 (to deck, slip track) vs H/A301 (furring stops above ceiling). Loaded E/A301 (to deck, more material)
A.delta: stud height (B.O. deck 22.83 - (ceiling + ~1.0)) per stud of B2E walls; slip track vs standard track on B2E LF

B.texto: No code requirement for furring height

rfis.assumption_loaded: B2E studs to deck with 2" slip track; board to ceiling + 6" (E/A301)

rfis.question: Types D6F and D6G: the WALL TAG KEY (I/A301) says middle digit 6 = 6" studs, but the TYPE 'D' schedule prints 3 5/8" for D6F and D6G. Which stud size?

A.texto: Tag key 6 = 6" (I/A301) vs schedule 3 5/8" (TYPE D/A301). Loaded 6" (conservative)
A.delta: D6F (4 tags) + D6G (2 tags): studs and tracks 6" instead of 3-5/8" on their LF

rfis.question: Stud gauge and O.C. are not printed for the partition types (only A2: 'MIN. 25 GAUGE ... 16" O.C.'; A502 soffits '20 GA'); A301 notes refer to S501 / S001 which are not in the set; S100 has no cold-formed framing notes; spec 09 22 16 is performance-based (min 0.0147").

A.texto: Plans: A2 25 ga @ 16"; A502 20 ga @ 24" (soffits); S200 'MTL STUDS @ 16"oc MAX PER ARCH'. Loaded 16" O.C. all partitions; 20 ga (33 mil) for walls to deck (heads D/E, ~22 ft) and 25 ga (min.) for walls stopping at ceiling (heads C/F/G)
A.delta: 20 ga vs 25 ga changes stud weight/cost on head D/E LF; O.C. 16" vs 24" = +50 % studs

B.texto: Code: interior lateral 5 psf (S100) with L/240 per ASTM C754 / manufacturer limiting heights determine gauge

rfis.assumption_loaded: 16" O.C.; 20 ga head D/E walls, 25 ga head C/F/G walls

rfis.question: Gypsum board type: plans and A301 say '5/8" GYP BD'; spec 09 29 00 2.3 lists only 5/8" Type X as interior gypsum board (and MR board with Type X core). Is Type X required throughout?

A.texto: Plans '5/8" GYP BD' (regular) vs spec 09 29 00 2.3.A Type X. Loaded 5/8" Type X (spec, conservative); MR Type X at wet rooms
A.delta: price difference Type X vs regular on all board SF

B.texto: IBC: only the X6D 1 HR wall (UL U465) requires Type X

rfis.assumption_loaded: 5/8" Type X everywhere; 5/8" Type X MR in locker rooms, restrooms, showers

rfis.question: Tile backer conflict: A301 type notes '5/8" CEMENT BACKER BOARD BEHIND ALL TILE'; elevation general note 14 'PROVIDE DENSSHIELD TILE BACKER AT ALL WALL TILE LOCATIONS'; note 15 'PROVIDE DENSARMOR PLUS SHEATHING AT ALL RESTROOM, TOILET, SHOWER & LOCKER ROOM WALL TILE LOCATIONS'; spec 09 29 00 cementitious backer units 5/8". Which backer?

A.texto: A301 + spec: 5/8" cement backer; A421.B-A437.A elevation notes 14/15: DensShield / DensArmor Plus. Loaded 5/8" cement backer behind tile
A.delta: cement board vs DensShield/DensArmor price on tile-face SF

B.texto: Code: ANSI A108/A118 / TCNA: cementitious backer at wet areas; glass-mat water resistant backer allowed

rfis.assumption_loaded: 5/8" cement backer board behind all tile

rfis.question: X6D (1 HR, UL U465): 'SEE SCHED. BELOW FOR NUMBER OF LAYERS REQ'D' but the schedule gives no layer count; the detail draws 2 layers each side; UL U465 1 HR = 1 layer 5/8" Type X each side.

A.texto: X/A301 drawing: 2 layers each side. Loaded 2 layers each side (as drawn)
A.delta: +1 layer each side on X6D LF x height

B.texto: UL U465 1 HR: one layer 5/8" Type X each side

rfis.question: C-5 'SUSPENDED GYPSUM CEILING - ARMSTRONG FLAT DRYWALL SUSPENSION SYSTEM' is specified under 09 51 23 (acoustical ceilings: HD8906 main runner, XL8945P 48" cross tee, KAM molding, DW90CAG clip, SB12P hanger). Is the drywall grid by the drywall contractor or by the ACT contractor?

A.texto: A121 C-5 + spec 09 51 23 list the drywall grid. Loaded grid + board in our scope (mains 48" O.C., cross tees 16" O.C. Armstrong standard)
A.delta: drywall grid main/cross tees, molding and hangers for ~524 SF of new C-5 ceiling

B.texto: Code: ASTM C635/C636 (grid), ASTM E580 seismic n/a (SDC B)

rfis.question: Soffit framing size/gauge where A502 says 'METAL STUD SOFFIT FRAMING SEE STRUCTURAL' (16/A502, 12/A502) - the structural sheets have no soffit detail; and the A421.A storefront soffits (8'-6" x2, 10'-0") have no section callout.

A.texto: 16/A502 'see structural' (none). Loaded 6" 20 ga @ 24" O.C. as in 6, 7, 8, 13, 15/A502
A.delta: 6" vs 3-5/8" studs on ~92 LF of 16/A502 soffit sides; drop-edge framing of 3 storefront soffits (~37 LF)

rfis.assumption_loaded: 6" x 20 ga @ 24" O.C. for 16/A502; storefront soffit drop edges framed like 8/A502

rfis.question: 8/A502 headwall between 101 LOBBY (P-16) and 103 RETAIL (P-4) on A421.A: both sides are exposed structure (C-7) and no soffit height is printed. What is the bottom of the headwall?

A.texto: A421.A: no SOFFIT HGT tag at the 8/A502 line. Loaded bottom at 10'-0" (adjacent C-5 strip) -> framing 12.83 ft x 14.39 ft
A.delta: each 1 ft lower = +14.4 SF board per face and +1 ft per stud

rfis.question: 9/A502 (called at the strip west of 106 SMOOTHIE STORAGE on A421.A) is titled 'CEILING DETAIL AND SOFFIT' with '2 LAYERS OF GYP BD TO WRAP FITNESS CINEMA SOFFIT' - there is no fitness cinema at that location. Does 9/A502 apply as drawn?

A.texto: Loaded as drawn: 1'-0" drop, 6" and 3-5/8" studs @ 16", 2 layers wrap, 7.5 ft
A.delta: 1 layer vs 2 layers on the 7.5 ft soffit wrap

rfis.question: Door / storefront heads: 6/A602, 8/A602, 1/A602 say 'STEEL HEADER @ HEAD LOCATIONS - REF: STRUCT.' but no structural sheet shows door or storefront headers. Steel by others or metal stud box header?

A.texto: Structural silent. Loaded metal stud box header (4 pieces, R.O. + 1'-4") per SKILL E19/E20
A.delta: box header LF = (R.O. + 1.33) x 4 per opening if ours; 0 if steel by others

B.texto: Code: AISI S212 headers (design by others)

rfis.assumption_loaded: metal stud box header at every framed opening

rfis.question: A103 metal backing items (CONT MTL TRACK 6 x 16 GA; WOOD OR MTL STRAP -> metal) give heights but no lengths; the AV niche (10/A505.B) horizontal studs have no width.

A.texto: Lengths = millwork / locker runs on the elevations (wall tasks). Loaded: run length of the millwork drawn on the elevation of each tagged wall; AV niche 2 studs x one stud bay
A.delta: per tag: rows x millwork length LF of 6" 16 ga track

rfis.question: RTU curb cap 2/A131 (600S162-33 stud frame 12" OC + #10 TEK @ 6") is not called on the roof plan: which curbs get capped and what size? (AD103 D0.18 removes existing mechanical equipment at 9 locations.)

A.texto: Detail exists, no callout. Loaded 9 curb caps (AD103 D0.18 count), frame size PENDING
A.delta: per curb: perimeter + cross members @ 12" of 600S162-33 + screws @ 6"

rfis.question: Access panels: P602 'PROVIDE 12X12 ACCESS PANEL IN PLUMBING WALLS FOR SERVICING OF TRAP PRIMER VALVES' - valve locations/quantity not shown; G002 item 76 swimsuit spinner access panel - no spinner on plan (pool infilled).

A.texto: Loaded: 1 signage panel (A131 A4.10); trap primer panels PENDING (1 per primer valve when located); spinner 0
A.delta: +1 12x12 panel per trap primer valve

B.texto: IPC 2021 / UPC: valves shall be accessible

rfis.question: AD102 D0.63 'REPAIR AND INFILL EXISTING HARDLID CEILING' (10 occurrences: restrooms / showers) and D0.59 'REMOVE 24" OF GYP. BOARD FROM BOTTOM OF THIS WALL' (2 occurrences): extents not dimensioned. What quantity of GWB patch / infill and new board at the 24" removal?

A.texto: Loaded as allowance (no quantity); D0.59 walls: new board 24" high on the face (FRT plywood A1.11/A1.13 replaces gyp to 24" AFF - wood EXCLUDED)

rfis.question: Head G (C3G, D3G, D6G) says 'WALL CAP, REF 7/A501' but 7/A501 is 'TYP. LIGHTED MIRROR SECTION'. Which cap detail applies (9/A501 SS-2 solid surface cap or 5/A501 1 1/2" wood trim)?

A.texto: Loaded: cap by millwork (not ours); top of wall = track, no board on top
A.delta: 0 for framing; +board on top if a gyp-wrapped cap is intended

rfis.assumption_loaded: no gyp board on the top of head G walls

rfis.question: A301 type notes 'REF S501 FOR STUD SIZE, SPACING, ANCHORING AND MAX HEIGHT' (and S001) - sheets S001/S501 are not in the bid set (S100, S101, S200, S300 only).

A.texto: Loaded: stud size from the schedule/tag key, spacing per RFI-04, anchorage per S200 schedule (Hilti X-U @ 16")
A.delta: see RFI-04

rfis.question: Smoothie bar sections 10/11/12/A503.C: 'CASEWORK FRAMING' on a 'TREATED BASE PLATE' with 3/4" CDX plywood, 5/8" gyp board one face and cement board with tile the other. Is the bar framing metal studs (ours) or casework framing by the millwork vendor (wood)?

A.texto: Loaded: framing by millwork (wood, EXCLUDED); if the A421 task finds a tagged partition at the bar, its board stays
A.delta: bar length x height of metal studs + board if ours

rfis.question: New wall with door 141 across Exit Corridor 141 (rev 8 cloud, A101) has no partition tag on any sheet. Which type?

A.texto: Plan: no tag; poche 3.36 pt = 6" like tagged A6D walls on A101; loaded A6D head D to deck (5.23 LF)
A.delta: A6C: same LF, head C (stud to ceiling 9'-0" + 6" instead of deck); A3C: 3-5/8" studs on 5.23 LF

B.texto: No code requirement; corridor wall not rated on G003

rfis.question: Head C (C/A301, types A3C, A6C, C3C): stud extension above the ceiling is drawn (~6") but not dimensioned, and several head-C walls face rooms open to structure. Confirm: stud = highest adjacent ceiling + 6"; to B.O. deck where a face is open to structure / finished to deck in elevation?

A.texto: Plan: C/A301 drawn ~6" (not dimensioned); elevations A422.C, A424.C, A425.C, A435.A finish some faces to "B.O. DECK". Loaded: ceiling + 6"; deck where a face is open/finished to deck (one criterion for all head-C walls)
A.delta: to-deck everywhere: +(22.83 - ceiling - 0.5) ft of stud on the head-C walls now at ceiling + 6"; ceiling-only everywhere: -(22.83 - ceiling - 0.5) ft of stud and board on the faces now to deck

B.texto: ASTM C754 / spec 09 22 16 3.2: braced partitions stopping above ceiling are acceptable when bracing to structure is provided (C/A301 "WALL BRACING - RE: STRUCT.")

rfis.assumption_loaded: ceiling + 6"; deck where the face is open/finished to deck

rfis.question: Untagged 3-5/8" new walls (Men's Locker trough-sink wing walls A-A424-13/-14, Women's Janitor 138 west wall A-A425-5, Women's locker vanity niche) carry no tag. Which type?

rfis.question: Keynote A2.25 "existing door opening to be infilled with metal and drywall" (A434, Light Weights 149 / Electrical 118): type and height of the infill not printed.

rfis.question: Lift Lab curved wall: A101 keynote A1.15 "impact gypsum board to 24" AFF" on the curved wall, but AD101 D0.15 keeps the existing curved storefront. Is new curved framing / board required (~42.5 LF)?

rfis.question: Existing walls to remain with keynotes A1.11 / A1.13 (FRT plywood / mirror backing, Lift Lab & Weights) and AD101 D0.07 / note 5 ("remove existing finish materials and substrate where required", exterior furring removed to CMU): is new furring / board required on those existing walls?

rfis.question: Family Restroom 105 ceiling: A421.A RCP prints 12'-1" while the A421.C elevations show 9'-0". Which governs board height?

rfis.question: A103 backing key 8: continuous track at 5'-5" AFF on a 5'-0" high (T.O. 60") D3G low wall. Where does the backing go?

rfis.question: Opening heads not dimensioned: D6F 8'-0" cased opening (5/A429.A "ALIGN" with door 115 = 7'-0"), Studio Entry 6'-6" opening (head at 9'-0" C-5 soffit, A426), storefront H (door 113) frame height (10'-0" like the other A601 frame types), door R.O. 3'-4" x 7'-2" (door + 2" frame).

rfis.question: Wet / service rooms outside A111 note 3 (janitors, laundry): MR board or type X? Sauna 115: DensArmor Plus full height or MR / type X to 7'-6"? X6D (A424-7): type X both faces to deck or rated face only?

A.delta: type X instead of MR: same SF, other product; X6D rated face only: ~-123 SF

rfis.question: Women's locker vanity end caps (A423 tag PT0130) are tagged C3D (furring, head D to deck) although they read as free-standing caps of the locker recess. Confirm type C3D.

rfis.question: B2E furring (A301 TYPE B) prints stud size 2". A 2" stud is not a standard SSMA depth (1-5/8", 2-1/2", 3-5/8"). Which member?

A.texto: Plan: 2" on A301 TYPE B; loaded 2-1/2" studs / track on all B2E (103.96 LF), next standard depth up
A.delta: 1-5/8" (162): lighter member on the same 103.96 LF, no LF change

B.texto: SSMA standard depths 162 / 250 / 362 / 600; a 2" furring is usually 1-5/8" or 2-1/2" (or hat / Z furring)
